placementInstrument.placementDefinition: smallest strictly larger wholly-containing observation; exact key is parent proposal scale + train-frozen target geometry bins (relative dx, dy, area contraction, aspect relation) + capped immediate-sibling count
placementInstrument.unplacedObservations: retained diagnostically but excluded from primary placement-law cells

hypothesis.statement: The degree-conditioned junction law is further conditioned by a component's structural placement within a larger observed whole. Exact masked structural slot, already frozen independently of this law test, can separate strict matching from strict reversal within the same degree.
hypothesis.rationale: The degree test leaves stable sublaws but also same-degree contradictions. The preceding frozen checkpoint explicitly routes failure upward to component placement. The prior masked-slot instrument provides a target-topology-free placement coordinate without introducing provenance.
hypothesis.falsification: If the same degree + exact masked placement + arm context supports both STRICT_MATCH and STRICT_REVERSE across independent sources, this placement coordinate is insufficient.

measurement.placementToken: P + first 16 hex characters of sha256(maskedContextKey); token map frozen with experiment inputs
measurement.endpointCenters: retained in compiler output but excluded from primary junction analysis
measurement.nullContract: unchanged source-local null: within each observation, arm tokens are deterministically permuted only among centers with identical center kind and degree. Placement is observation-level and therefore constant through observed and all 64 null worlds.
measurement.strictMatch: observed matching accuracy > every one of 64 source-local null matching accuracies
measurement.strictReverse: observed matching accuracy < every one of 64 source-local null matching accuracies

sequentialCustody.step1: Join train law measurements to frozen train placement tokens only; discover and freeze degree+placement+arm catalogue.
sequentialCustody.step2: Apply frozen catalogue to holdout with no refit.
sequentialCustody.step3: Apply surviving holdout catalogue to control with no refit.
sequentialCustody.joinBlindness: Placement data and degree-law data were each previously frozen independently. Before this protocol freeze, no degree-law state was joined to maskedContextKey in any lane. The protected object is the cross-dataset relationship, not the already-existing marginals.
sequentialCustody.provenance: No provenance, institution, object type, culture, language, chronology, occupant token, family id, or target topology enters discovery, validation, or confirmation.

trainDiscovery.cellEligibility: degree+placement+arm must have >=10 eligible train sources
classification: MATCH_ONLY if >=5 STRICT_MATCH sources and 0 STRICT_REVERSE
REVERSE_ONLY if >=5 STRICT_REVERSE sources and 0 STRICT_MATCH
trainDiscovery.candidateLaws: Only MATCH_ONLY or REVERSE_ONLY cells enter the frozen catalogue.

validation.passRule: Among decided cells (STRICT_MATCH + STRICT_REVERSE), >=90% reproduce the train-frozen direction and at least 5 reproduce it.
validation.contradictionRule: Every opposite strict state is retained and counted.

verdict.SUPPORTED: Every train-admitted placement law passes holdout and control, and no tested degree+placement+arm cell with >=10 eligible sources is MIXED in holdout or control.
verdict.PARTIAL: At least one train-admitted placement law validates and confirms, but another tested placement cell is MIXED, fails, or lacks transfer.
verdict.REJECTED: No train-admitted placement law survives both holdout and control, or the dominant train placement cells remain MIXED in independent lanes.
